content: This is a list of minerals that have corresponding Wikipedia articles. The names of mineral varieties and mineraloids are included after the valid minerals for each letter. For a comprehensive list of all mineral names, which includes approximately 4,000 entries, refer to the List of minerals (complete). The minerals are sorted alphabetically by name. Minerals Starting with A: Abelsonite: A rare nickel porphyrin mineral. Abenakiite-(Ce): A rare sodium, cerium, and iron silicate mineral. Abernathyite: A hydrated potassium uranium arsenate mineral. Abhurite: A tin hydroxychloride mineral. Abswurmbachite: A copper manganese silicate mineral. Actinolite: A member of the amphibole group, typically green in color. Acuminite: A rare calcium aluminum fluoride mineral. Adamite: A zinc arsenate mineral, often found in green or yellow hues. Adamsite-(Y): A rare yttrium silicate mineral. Adelite: A calcium magnesium arsenate mineral. Admontite: A rare hydrated magnesium borate mineral. Aegirine: A sodium iron silicate mineral, part of the pyroxene group. Aenigmatite: A sodium iron titanium silicate mineral. Aerinite: A blue silicate mineral, often associated with zeolites. Aerugite: A rare arsenic mineral with a greenish hue. Aeschynite-(Ce): A cerium titanium niobium oxide mineral. Aeschynite-(Nd): A neodymium titanium niobium oxide mineral. Aeschynite-(Y): A yttrium titanium niobium oxide mineral. Aetites: Also known as eagle stones, these are iron oxide concretions. Afghanite: A blue or white tectosilicate mineral. Afwillite: A calcium silicate hydrate mineral. Agardite: A group of rare earth arsenate minerals. Agrellite: A sodium calcium silicate mineral. Agrinierite: A uranium oxide hydrate mineral. Aguilarite: A silver selenium sulfide mineral. Aheylite: A phosphate mineral in the turquoise group. Ahlfeldite: A nickel selenite mineral. Aikinite: A lead copper bismuth sulfide mineral. Ajoite: A copper aluminum silicate hydroxide mineral. Akaganéite: A chloride-containing iron oxide mineral. Akatoreite: A rare lead arsenate mineral. Akdalaite: A rare aluminum oxide hydroxide mineral. Åkermanite: A calcium magnesium silicate mineral. Aksaite: A magnesium borate hydrate mineral. Alabandite: A manganese sulfide mineral. Alamosite: A lead silicate mineral. Alarsite: An aluminum arsenate mineral. Albite: A sodium-rich feldspar mineral. Alforsite: A barium phosphate chloride mineral. Algodonite: A copper arsenide mineral. Aliettite: A magnesium aluminum silicate mineral. Allanite: A group of rare earth silicate minerals. Alloclasite: A cobalt arsenic sulfide mineral. Allophane: A hydrous aluminum silicate mineral. Almandine: A red garnet variety, rich in iron and aluminum. Alstonite: A barium calcium carbonate mineral. Altaite: A lead telluride mineral. Aluminite: A hydrated aluminum sulfate mineral. Aluminium: A metallic element, often found in bauxite ore. Alunite: A potassium aluminum sulfate mineral. Alunogen: A hydrated aluminum sulfate mineral. Amblygonite: A lithium aluminum phosphate mineral. Ameghinite: A rare sodium borate mineral. Amphibole (mineral group): A group of inosilicate minerals. Analcime: A sodium aluminum silicate mineral, part of the zeolite group. Anatase: A titanium dioxide mineral. Andalusite: An aluminum silicate mineral, often found in metamorphic rocks. Andesine: A sodium calcium feldspar mineral. Andradite: A calcium iron garnet mineral. Anglesite: A lead sulfate mineral. Anhydrite: A calcium sulfate mineral, often found in evaporite deposits. Ankerite: A calcium iron magnesium carbonate mineral. Annabergite: A nickel arsenate mineral, often green in color. Anorthite: A calcium-rich feldspar mineral. Anorthoclase: A sodium potassium feldspar mineral. Anthophyllite: An amphibole mineral, often fibrous. Antigorite: A magnesium silicate mineral, part of the serpentine group. Antimony: A metallic element, often found in stibnite. Antitaenite: A nickel-iron alloy mineral. Antlerite: A copper sulfate mineral. Apatite (mineral group): A group of phosphate minerals. Apophyllite: A group of hydrated potassium calcium silicate minerals. Aragonite: A calcium carbonate mineral, polymorph of calcite. Archerite: A rare potassium ammonium phosphate mineral. Arctite: A rare sodium calcium phosphate mineral. Arcubisite: A silver copper sulfide mineral. Arfvedsonite: A sodium amphibole mineral. Argentite: A silver sulfide mineral. Argutite: A rare tin oxide mineral. Armalcolite: A titanium iron oxide mineral. Arsenic: A metalloid element, often found in realgar and orpiment. Arsenopyrite: An iron arsenic sulfide mineral. Arthurite: A copper iron arsenate mineral. Artinite: A magnesium carbonate hydrate mineral. Artroeite: A lead aluminum fluoride mineral. Asisite: A lead oxide chloride mineral. Astrophyllite: A potassium iron titanium silicate mineral. Atacamite: A copper chloride hydroxide mineral. Atheneite: A rare palladium arsenide mineral. Aubertite: A copper aluminum sulfate mineral. Augelite: An aluminum phosphate mineral. Augite: A calcium magnesium iron silicate mineral, part of the pyroxene group. Aurichalcite: A copper zinc carbonate hydroxide mineral. Auricupride: A copper gold alloy mineral. Aurostibite: A gold antimony sulfide mineral. Autunite: A hydrated calcium uranium phosphate mineral. Axinite (mineral group): A group of borosilicate minerals. Azurite: A copper carbonate hydroxide mineral, often deep blue in color. This is a detailed description of the minerals starting with A.
